name: nuclear receptor coactivator 2
pathways: mRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: NCOA2 encodes nuclear receptor coactivator 2. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription coregulator activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and mRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Chondrosarcoma; Rhabdomyosarcoma; MEIS1::NCOA1/2 primitive spindle cell sarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
